_doc: Thresholds for the nightly long run (scripts/nightly-run.mjs, workflow nightly-run.yml, issue #574). The run plays a headless Fellowship with mock local minds (no paid API, no Ollama) and fails when one is crossed; the failure opens or updates the issue 'Nightly agent run failed'. Change a number here in the same PR that moves the behaviour it guards. idle is judged by maxIdleGameHours, not a count (the mock minds only wait, so short idles are expected). The minds are mock-table:1b (#822): it hunts the home ground and answers a Table scene with a legal option, because mock-tools could not, so every scene went to reflex (reflex-scenes) and runners that lost five answers in a row ended and left their members on scripted rules (stuck-state); reflex-votes, no-aim and repeated-narration are properties of the mocks and are not limited.
